title: Too Short to Search
description: A single letter shouldn't trigger a dropdown full of every port on Earth. The address autocomplete waits for at least two characters before it bothers the mocked geocoding endpoint at all.
successCondition: Typing a single character into either the Origin or Destination field on /book renders no suggestions dropdown; typing a second character (two total, matching a known freight hub label) does render the suggestions list.
hints: The threshold is a client-side check (query.trim().length < 2) before the geocode API is even called — a network inspector will show no request fires for a 1-character query.
Clear the field back to empty between the two checks so leftover suggestions from a prior query don't give a false pass.
